question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

_ B I R _ I R B _
solution:
Given : _ B I R _ I R B _

By checking options :

 
• CBH → __**C**__ B I R __**B**__ I R B __**H**__ → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• RBI → **__R__** B I R __B__ I R B **__I__** → (It follows the pattern of
